From: Susan Perkins <susan.perkins@medicahealth.com>

Cc: legal@medicahealth.com, procurement@medicahealth.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Data processing agreement request and evidence for pilot

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency numbers. Procurement asked me to get the DPA in place before the pilot spins up next month. Attached is the counterparty DPA template we use (we generally redline via Word). Two quick asks up front: can Redwood accept our standard SCCs reference in section 4, and do you have the SOC 2 report and SIG questionnaire PDF we can review?

We also need confirmation on:
- Data residency during the pilot (US-only)
- Retention default (we normally ask for 90 days for logs)

I attached our DPA template for reference (not redlined yet). Can we get an initial redline back by end of week? If legal wants a quick sync, Susan and I are available Thursday afternoon.

Thanks —
Susan Perkins
Head of Procurement, MedicaHealth
susan.perkins@medicahealth.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: Medica_DPA_template_v3.docx (Word doc)
From: markus_klein@redwood.ai <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Perkins <susan.perkins@medicahealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Data processing agreement request and evidence for pilot

Susan —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the template. Looping in Neha (privacy lead) and Aditya (your commercial contact) so we can cover legal and PO/terms questions.

Initial notes (high level):
- SCCs: we are able to include the EU Standard Contractual Clauses where applicable. For a US-only pilot we typically document the processing scope in the DPA and reference SCCs for future cross-border flows.
- Retention: 90 days for operational logs is reasonable; we usually offer configurable retention per-customer.
- Residency: we can pin pilot workloads to US-only regions — will confirm the region and the availability zone with infra team.

I attached our first-pass redline to your template (Medica_DPA_redline_v1.docx). It's intentionally conservative where security or data residency is concerned; Neha will flag anything she thinks needs alternate language.

Next steps proposed:
1) Neha to review redline and call out any compliance evidence gaps (SOC 2 sections, HIPAA scoping, SIG/CAIQ responses).
2) If Medica legal is OK with the redline, Aditya will get the commercial signature path and PO details finalized.
3) We'll route the DPA via DocuSign once counters are accepted — suggest signer order: Medica legal -> Medica exec -> Redwood GC -> Redwood exec.

I can do a 30-min sync Thu 3pm PT if that works for you and your counsel.

—
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, West
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai | (510) 555-2034

Attachment: Medica_DPA_redline_v1.docx (Word doc)

Markus / Neha —

Thanks for the redline. A couple of points from Medica legal we want to get on the record before routing to exec signers:
1) Section 5.2 (Subprocessors) — we need a current subprocessor list and confirmation of 30 days notice prior to onboarding any new subprocessor that will process PHI.
2) Security evidence — please provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II (redacted OK) and the SIG export. The SIG export you attached looks like a summary; can you confirm whether you have a full CAIQ/STAR report or an internal control map?
3) Indemnity cap — suggest language to limit to fees paid under the MSA in the prior 12 months; our finance team wants to avoid open-ended exposure.

We can do the Thursday sync but prefer to keep it to 20 minutes to confirm open items.

Regards,
Claire Zhang
Senior Counsel, MedicaHealth
legal@medicahealth.com

Claire / Susan —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers inline below and attached a slightly tightened DPA redline that addresses the subprocessor notice and indemnity cap language you requested.

- Subprocessors: current list attached (Medica_DPA_redline_v1.docx includes appendix). We can commit to 30 days notice for new subprocessors that will process PHI; for non-PHI subprocessors we can provide notice and an opt-out conversation for 10 business days.
- SOC 2 & evidence: attached is our recently completed SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and the full SIG/CAIQ export (Medica_SIG_export_2028-06.pdf). The CAIQ is the basis for our control mapping; if you want a deeper walkthrough we can have our security team join the call.
- Indemnity: we proposed language capping liability at fees paid under the MSA in the prior 12 months; if Medica needs a higher cap tied to the pilot value we can discuss with finance.

Next steps:
1) If the attached redline is acceptable, please confirm and we'll prepare DocuSign envelope.
2) Aditya will coordinate PO details with procurement.
3) Neha can share a brief control summary doc ahead of pilot kickoff.

I am scheduling the 20-min sync for Thu 14:00 PT (invite sent) — if that doesn't work please propose alternate.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, West
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai | (510) 555-2034
